issue.body:
Adds single and multiple repository delete endpoint and UIs.

**There is a known issue for repositories with commas in their name** where loading their detail panel results in a 404 due to an ES issue: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/40817. Repositories with commas in their name also can't be deleted using this new delete endpoint. Since the fix on ES side will likely be putting some character restrictions for the name, I'm ignoring that edge case for now.

Confirmation modal for multiple delete by selecting repositories from table:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1965714/55594077-23d95c80-56f3-11e9-837b-687e50d41312.png)

Confirmation modal for single delete:

issue.body:
Applies the same naming restrictions to repositories as to snapshots except that leading underscores and uppercase characters are permitted.

Fixes #40817.
